scripts.install:all: npm --prefix functions install && npm --prefix web-display install
scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix web-display run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix functions test && npm --prefix web-display test
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-interactive-menu --only firestore 'npm --prefix functions run test:rules:direct'
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix functions run build && ENFORCE_APP_CHECK=false firebase emulators:exec --project demo-interactive-menu --only auth,firestore,functions 'DISPLAY_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5000 npm run seed -- --project=demo-interactive-menu --id=main --code=my-cafe --pin=123456 --name=Кафе && npm --prefix functions run test:e2e:direct'
